notes: The Gen 9 cohort (configs/round9-cohort.json, opened on g9's go at 06:16 UTC). First start prepares {out}/run from the opened plan with 10,000 fresh deals (seed 9013, same as the preflight; lists fetched over HTTPS and checked against pins); every start runs ops/publish_gen5.py every minute to the feed branch arena-gen9-azure4-feed from a git checkout at {out}/publication (git init + remote from BRIDGE_FEED_REMOTE over the box's boxctl SSH key, orphan branch on first push), and ops/gen5_runtime.py with 5 workers in the foreground (1 core left for the publisher's export). Resumable on restart; STOP in {out}/run drains it. About 300 boards an hour, so a little over a day. Needs the python with TensorFlow (/home/bridgebots/work/venv/bin/python, as the preflight used).
